topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this is happening, it's like a nightmare. They're saying you cheated, but I know you, I know the kind of person you are. We've spent countless nights in the library, you more often than me, always pushing yourself to do the best work you can. This has to be some kind of misunderstanding, a terrible, awful mistake. We need to figure this out, to show them the real you, the real work. We can't let this destroy everything you've worked for. Just hold on, okay? I'm right here, and we're going to fix this.
